Learn About Digital Gold & Silver

Understand digital Gold and Silver, recurring savings, prices, charges, selling and redemption through simple guides.

01

Understanding digital metals

Digital Gold and Silver purchases happen online. Before buying, check the provider’s ownership model, metal purity, storage terms and options for accessing your holdings.

Explore Gold
02

One-time or regular savings

A recurring purchase is an instruction to buy metal at selected intervals. Each purchase uses the applicable price and is subject to provider terms, taxes and charges.

Explore saving options
03

Prices, quantity and charges

Review the buy price, unit, timestamp, taxes and fees. The quantity you receive depends on this full calculation, not simply the amount you enter.

Understand pricing
04

Saving with a goal in mind

A goal helps organise your contributions around a milestone. Metal prices fluctuate, so a target contribution amount does not guarantee the value of your holdings.

Plan your contributions
05

Selling, redemption and delivery

Available routes depend on the provider. Check minimum quantities, serviceable locations, charges and timelines before choosing how to use your holdings.

Explore Silver
06

Know what you’re comparing

Digital holdings, physical bullion and jewellery differ in purchase process, storage, fees and redemption. Understand these terms rather than assuming every option works the same way.

See the journey
